title: Luxury 30A Vacation Home with Private Pool, Golf Cart & Lake Views
meta_description: Tucked Away offers a 6BR/5.5BA retreat for 14 guests with a private saltwater pool, EV charger, and golf cart—steps from Seagrove Beach and 30A dining.
description_expanded: AboutNew Rental | Tucked Away | Luxury 30A Vacation Rental in Seagrove Beach with Private Saltwater Pool, 6-Seater Street Legal Golf Cart Included, Bikes, and Lakeside Setting Why Guests Love Tucked Away • 6-seater street legal golf cart included • Large private saltwater pool with sun shelf and resort-style lounge seating • Complimentary bikes for cruising 30A bike paths and nearby beach towns • Prime south side of 30A location in Seagrove Beach near Walton Dunes Beach Access • Close to sugar-white sand beaches and emerald Gulf waters • Open-concept coastal luxury living designed for comfort and connection • Fully equipped gourmet kitchen with premium appliances, wine fridge, and ice maker • EV charging station with Juicebox for electric vehicles • Gas fire table for cozy evenings under the stars • Outdoor alfresco dining with gas grill overlooking Tresca Lake • Parking for up to six vehicles • Serene lakeside setting near Eastern Lake access • Complimentary beach chairs and umbrella included • High-speed Wi-Fi and Smart TVs throughout • Close to boutique shopping, dining, and entertainment along 30A • Welcome package with Starbucks coffee, bottled waters, and essential starter amenities A Luxury 30A Vacation Rental Designed for Elevated Coastal Living Welcome to Tucked Away, a stunning luxury 30A vacation rental located in the heart of Seagrove Beach on the highly desirable south side of Scenic Highway 30A. Designed to comfortably accommodate up to 14 guests, this spacious coastal retreat blends modern luxury, outdoor entertainment, and effortless beach access — making it ideal for families, multi-generational groups, and friends seeking the ultimate Emerald Coast getaway. From the moment you arrive, the charming front porch with Adirondack chairs and a relaxing swing sets the tone for a memorable stay. Inside, the open-concept living area offers plush seating, abundant natural light, and a large Smart TV — the perfect gathering space after sun-filled beach days. Resort-Style Outdoor Living with Private Saltwater Pool The outdoor spaces at Tucked Away are designed to rival a private resort. The large saltwater pool features a sun shelf ideal for children and relaxing afternoons under the Florida sun. Lounge chairs surround the pool deck, creating space for both relaxation and connection. As the sun sets, gather around the gas fire table for cozy evenings and conversation. Enjoy grilling fresh Gulf seafood on the gas grill and dining alfresco on the covered deck overlooking tranquil Tresca Lake. Whether swimming, lounging, or entertaining, this backyard oasis is built for unforgettable memories. 6-Seater Street Legal Golf Cart Included One of the most sought-after amenities on 30A — your stay includes a 6-seater street legal golf cart, making it effortless to reach Walton Dunes Beach Access in just minutes. Cruise Scenic Highway 30A, explore Seagrove Beach, visit Seaside, or head to nearby dining and boutiques without ever needing to move your vehicle. Combined with the complimentary bikes, your group can easily experience everything 30A is known for. Chef-Ready Gourmet Kitchen and Elegant Dining The fully stocked gourmet kitchen is both stylish and functional, featuring: • Premium stainless steel appliances • Large island with bar seating • Wine refrigerator • Ice maker • Quality cookware and serveware Enjoy meals at the elegant dining table seating ten guests or step outside for lakeside dining under the covered deck. The open layout ensures everyone stays connected, whether preparing meals, sharing stories, or planning the next beach adventure. Spacious Bedrooms for Comfort and Privacy Tucked Away offers thoughtfully designed sleeping arrangements for up to 14 guests. First Floor • Primary king suite with private bathroom and walk-in shower Second Floor • Two king suites with private ensuite bathrooms • Two queen bedrooms with shared full bathroom • Bunk room featuring twin-over-twin bunks perfect for children or teens Each bedroom offers comfort, privacy, and high-quality furnishings to ensure restful nights after full beach days. Prime Seagrove Beach Location on the South Side of 30A Located just five minutes from Walton Dunes Beach Access, this luxury Seagrove Beach vacation rental places you close to: • Eastern Lake • Scenic 30A bike trail • Seaside • Alys Beach • Boutique shopping and dining • Local coffee shops and live entertainment The lakeside setting offers tranquility while remaining near the vibrant energy of 30A. Designed for Convenience and Modern Travel Tucked Away includes: • Parking for six vehicles • Juicebox EV charging station • High-speed Wi-Fi • Complimentary beach chairs and umbrella • Starter amenities including Starbucks coffee and bottled waters Every detail has been thoughtfully curated to make your stay seamless and comfortable. Frequently Asked Questions Is the golf cart included? Yes. A 6-seater street legal golf cart is included with your stay. How far is the beach? Walton Dunes Beach Access is approximately five minutes away by golf cart or a short walk. Does the home have a private pool? Yes. The home features a large private saltwater pool with a sun shelf. Is there EV charging? Yes. The property includes a Juicebox EV charging station. Your Luxury 30A Escape Awaits With its private saltwater pool, included 6-seater street legal golf cart, bikes, gourmet kitchen, lakeside setting, and prime south side 30A location, Tucked Away stands out as one of the most desirable luxury vacation rentals in Seagrove Beach. Whether you are planning a summer beach vacation, Spring Break getaway, or multi-generational retreat, this home delivers space, style, and location in one extraordinary package. Book Tucked Away today and experience the best of Seagrove Beach and Scenic Highway 30A.
